HeroSection.subtext: A Full Stack Developer for the Web and Mobile.

AboutMe.title: About Me
AboutMe.description: I am a passionate full-stack developer with a focus on creating dynamic and responsive web applications.
AboutMe.description2: I have experience working with JavaScript, .NET Core, Angular, Node.js, Express, HTML, CSS, and Git. I am a quick learner and I am always looking to expand my knowledge and skill set. I am a team player and I am excited to work with others to create amazing applications.

Contact.title: Contact Me
Contact.description: I'm currently looking for new challenges, my inbox is always open.
Contact.description2: Whether you have a question or just want to say hi, I'll try my best to get back to you!
